confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors are firmest; July accommodation is peak-season and least certain (roughly +/-20-25%). Beer assumes a 0.5 L draft. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer relationship. Euro estimates were converted at an assumed working rate of about 1.15 USD per EUR, not a searched rate. The FX figure came from a rba.gov.au-restricted search result, not a direct page read; the search output flagged possible stale page dates, so confirm it on the RBA site.
comparable_city_reasoning: Model judgment, not a sourced benchmark: Berlin levels were positioned against other large German city-break markets such as Hamburg and Cologne, below Munich and above lower-cost Central European capitals such as Prague. July accommodation reflects peak summer demand.
